learning_outcomes.text: To become familiar with materials of biological origin
To consolidate the notions of the structural mechanisms used by Nature to create materials with defined properties
To use this knowledge towards the design of biomimetic materials
To be prepared for their diploma thesis in the field of natural biomaterials and their applications in tissue engineering
Development of interdisciplinary and critical thinking
Search for, analysis and synthesis of data and information, with the use of the necessary
Production of free, creative and inductive thinking

syllabus_topics: Silk, spider webs, mussel collagen, amyloid fibrils
Biological composite materials: nacre, chitin, bones, teeth
Application of natural biomaterials in tissue engineering
teaching_methods: Supportive learning through the use of valid online scientific tools, eg. proteopedia.org in order to understand biological structures

assessment_methods.method: Final written examination (Multiple-choice questions and Developing of topics)

assessment_rules: Students are evaluated by a final written examination in Greek that includes a combination of Multiple-choice questions and Developing of topics. Students have the right to view their exam scripts after the grading results are published and to ask questions.
